Summary: History from the durable store and persisted snapshots; scrubber rows from stored relationship versions (decision record step 8)
Description: 1) Original intent: Decision Record 2026-10-11 section 4 and step 8: History is a consumer of the same durable Canonical Relationship Store and of persisted analytical snapshots, so what a person sees over time cannot diverge from what Analysis and MAP show; the legacy formation-history scrubber (KRYL-1334) needs a replacement path. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) analytical snapshots are persisted with their subject, lookups, the relationship set they froze and the pinned temporal result, under ids that are unique across sessions; (b) History lists saved analyses and rebuilds a selected one as of its own time from the store with the same builders the live analysis uses (formation, relationship sentences, filing and evidence lines); a relationship admitted after the freeze is not part of the past analysis; a reference the store cannot resolve is reported, not invented; (c) the unnamed-affiliate wording and its documentation survive into History; (d) the MAP scrubber's rows for an entity are derived from the stored relationship versions (state transitions only), replacing the legacy formation_state read for entities; (e) History shows the same formation sentence and relationships as Analysis showed, in the same session and in a fresh browser session; (f) two entities live; existing suites green; benchmark baseline untouched. 3) Current implementation state: built. historyview.js (pure), analysishistory.jsx in the History bay, store history and recent-snapshot routes, snapshot ids unique across sessions, scrubber rows from the store; the legacy formation_state writer still runs but is no longer read for entities (to be removed in a later cleanup ticket). Tests: qa_history 12/12; live on two entities, same session and fresh session (qa_history_live). 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1402 (store), KRYL-1398 (snapshot), KRYL-1403, KRYL-1404. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no; it replaces the read path of KRYL-1334's scrubber for entity subjects. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes. Status: opened and built 2026-10-11.
